tasks.check: deno task artifact:check && deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno check --unstable-kv src/mod.ts src/client.ts src/fresh.ts src/kv.ts src/raw.ts src/testing.ts
tasks.doc: deno doc --lint src/mod.ts src/client.ts src/fresh.ts src/kv.ts src/raw.ts src/testing.ts
tasks.fixture:bare: deno task --cwd=examples/bare check && deno task --cwd=examples/bare test
tasks.fixture:fresh: deno task --cwd=examples/fresh check && deno task --cwd=examples/fresh build && deno task --cwd=examples/fresh e2e
tasks.ci:package: deno task check && deno task test && deno task doc && deno publish --dry-run --allow-dirty
tasks.ci: deno task ci:package && deno task fixture:bare && deno task fixture:fresh
tasks.publish:check: deno task artifact:check && deno task release:check && deno publish --dry-run --allow-dirty
